binary_identity_scope: Build receipt and process hashes cross-checked; executable binary bytes are not used by this analyzer

constants_from_source_authority.interpretation: Binding energies belong to species stocks; fit cutoffs determine grid discontinuities.

contracts.photon: per-total-H cohort stocks; q=E_eV*a; births at x=ln(a)
contracts.time: Archive dates identify provenance only; scientific time is x=ln(a), proper intervals in seconds
contracts.independence: No solver imports, provider calls, point-replay calls, or IVP execution
contracts.reference: Same physical kernel; archived Radau endpoint is a comparator with unbounded residual numerical uncertainty
contracts.scope: Fixed source birth/spectrum and FLRW geometry; no Full48/source-age/spectral/angular/Case-B/Bianchi/full-EoR promotion

raw_result.independence: Same continuous equations and microphysical kernel; different integration coordinates, not discrete event solver

tolerance_contract.note: tau absolute tolerance is dimensionless, not equal to absolute photon count tolerance
